source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: Why is seeing Markdown-style headings in an editor insufficient to confirm that a skill file was saved properly?

options.text: Typing Markdown headings automatically changes the saved format
options.feedback: Visible heading syntax does not establish the actual file format. A document can look like Markdown while still being saved as rich text.

options.text: Changing the filename also converts rich text into plain text
options.feedback: The filename and saved format are separate checks. A .md name does not by itself convert rich-text contents.

options.text: The saved format or filename may still be wrong
options.feedback: Appearance does not establish the saved file type. Check for plain-text Markdown and the intended filename before testing the skill.

options.text: Opening a file in an editor establishes that the agent can use it
options.feedback: An editor can display a document without proving it is saved as the intended skill file. Check the format and name, then test the result.
